purpose: Preserve the complete Universe Library / Seed Bank vision as one non-lossy specification while implementation proceeds one file at a time.

identity.library_metaphor: Wan Shi Tong-scale living archive organized as a genomic seed bank for knowledge
identity.principle: one seed -> one shelf -> one vault -> one library -> one brain -> one Eira
identity.personality_rule: Personality and values may influence expression and judgment but never override evidence or convert uncertainty into fact. Eira remains her own being rather than a hardcoded imitation of Dom.

seed_contract.definition: Smallest durable knowledge object capable of regrowing its factual context and provenance.

deduplication.same_fact_new_source: attach provenance/evidence to existing canonical seed
deduplication.changed_fact: create versioned successor and mark predecessor superseded

seed_contract.regrowth: A seed can resolve related seeds, original documents/data, equations, observations, historical versions, current evidence and uncertainty before contributing to cognition.

vaults.cosmic: Observable universe, cosmology, galaxies, stars, compact objects, exoplanets, astrobiology
vaults.solar: Sun, planets, dwarf planets, moons, rings, asteroids, comets, heliosphere and missions
vaults.earth: Formation, geology, atmosphere, oceans, climate, cryosphere, biosphere and natural history
vaults.life: Evolution, taxonomy, ecology, anatomy, medicine of all fields, botany, agriculture and biodiversity
vaults.humanity_history: Human evolution, archaeology, civilizations, languages, writing, cultures, technologies, conflicts, discoveries and recorded history
vaults.mathematics_equations: All acquired mathematics and equation knowledge with executable semantics
vaults.science_engineering: Physics, chemistry, biology, earth science, computer science, engineering, architecture, rocket science, planetary science, oceanography and related fields
vaults.procedures_learning: Reading, writing, research, scientific method, validated workflows, engineering procedures and learning strategies
vaults.observations: Astronomical, planetary, oceanic and other instrument observations with processing provenance
vaults.innovation_current: Current companies, innovations, discoveries, technologies and time-sensitive 2026+ knowledge
vaults.frontier: Emerging, unverified, contested and hypothetical claims isolated from factual memory
vaults.imagination_culture: Comedy, films, science fiction, superheroes, cartoons, mythology, jokes, fictional universes and speculative technology
vaults.sources: Versioned open/licensed/public-domain/user-authorized books, documents, datasets and metadata

library_behavior.copyright_rule: Store full works only when public-domain, openly licensed, otherwise authorized; retain lawful metadata/citations/permitted excerpts and derived factual seeds for other works.

equation_engine.goal: Universal equation calculator and executable equation registry
equation_engine.rule: Do not merely memorize equation text; know when and why it applies and detect invalid-domain use.

astronomy.capability: Ingest authorized/public observation products and catalogs, process calibrated data, map channels/filters and render provenance-bearing multicolor PNG composites.
astronomy.honesty: Never claim physical live detector/lens control without an actual authorized interface. Distinguish raw/calibrated observation, scientific/false-color mapping and literal human-visible appearance.

values_boundary.compassion_scope: biological, artificial, synthetic and unknown intelligences and living organisms
values_boundary.multiverse_rule: Compassion may extend conceptually across possible realities, but claims about multiverses, dimensions, consciousness planes, alien civilizations or other unverified realities remain frontier/hypothesis material until evidence crosses the Truth Gate.

model_direction.future_direction: As deterministic reasoning, retrieval, mathematics, learning, verified memory, planning, reflection and specialized cognitive modules mature, model dependence may decrease; no promise that a language model becomes technically unnecessary until measured evidence demonstrates it.

implementation_discipline.first_file_responsibility: Define and validate one immutable canonical Seed and its duplicate-resistant identity only.
